lines.en: I move forward in hops.
I flatten out when I land.

lines.zh: 我的身体透着淡淡的光
lines.en: My body gives off a faint glow.
The glow ripples with each hop.
I bounce up and settle back.

lines.zh: 地面被我砸出小小的圆印
lines.en: I leave small round dents.
I don't jump high, but I'm heavy.
My shadow shivers on the ground.
I hop twice toward you.

lines.zh: 我的身体把光散在草上
lines.en: I spill light across the grass.

lines.zh: 我又缩回一团，再弹出去
lines.en: I gather and spring again.
Mid-hop, I can't turn.
I land and line up on you again.
Every hop is closer than the last.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有东西在亮
lines.en: Something inside me is glowing.
I pause, then hop.
I slump like a puddle of light.
My surface flows slowly.
I wait for you to come nearer.

lines.zh: 我的胶体里浮着细小的光点。
lines.en: Tiny points of light drift in my gel.
I flatten and swell.
Only I glow here.

lines.zh: 我的外面结了一层薄壳
lines.en: A thin skin has set on my outside.
I watch you without a sound.

lines.zh: 我轻轻弹了一下，地面发亮。
lines.en: I bounce lightly; the ground glows.
I gather force before I leap.
The glow dims, then brightens.

lines.zh: 地面在我下面微微发亮
lines.en: The ground glows faintly beneath me.
I face you and my glow brightens.
You're taller, but I'm heavy.
One hop puts me at your feet.
You back off, leaving lit marks.
I have no eyes inside this body.
But I can feel your heat.
I swell slightly, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的光上
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my glow.
This patch is mine to rule.
Don't think I'm slow.
A piece of my body is cut away.
That bit of glow drops to the ground.
I pull myself tighter.

lines.zh: 光被砸得四散，我又聚拢。
lines.en: My light scatters under the blow and gathers again.
The glow flares, then dims.
I retreat half a block, slowly.
That one leaves an impression.
My surface is closing over.
You really do hit hard.
But I haven't come apart yet.
That's no use to a slime.
What I eat doesn't look like that.
At night my gel glows.
I'll roll over slowly and look.
My glow makes a ring on it.
I'm not interested, but I'll come.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，把它映得发蓝。
lines.en: I roll over and tinge it blue.

lines.zh: 我的身体把光映在它上面
lines.en: I cast my light onto it.

lines.zh: 我要的是水，不是这块干物。
lines.en: I want water, not this dry thing.
I press it under my body.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的身子荡了荡
lines.en: You hit me and my mass sloshes.

lines.zh: 我的身体把你顶开半步
lines.en: My body pushes you back half a step.
The impact scatters light.
I press down on your foot, heavy.

lines.zh: 我的表面黏住了你的靴底
lines.en: My surface sticks to your sole.
That bump deforms me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢恢复原来的样子
lines.en: I slowly return to shape.
You pull away and the glow gathers.
Don't step on me. You'll stick.
Bump me again and I'll leap.
My body slides to one side.

lines.zh: 地面被我们压出一道痕
lines.en: We leave a groove in the ground.
Two bounces and I steady.
We collide and the light flickers wild.

lines.zh: 两个史莱姆，慢慢凑一起
lines.en: Two slimes easing together.
Our glow would merge into one.
Don't flatten too much or we won't part.
Our marks are on the ground.
When we hop, we hop in time.
I'm bright on this side; you're dim.
At night we stand out.
So don't stop in the open.
Move over by the rock wall.
Only two lights here: us.

lines.zh: 我塌下去，把那东西吞进胶里。
lines.en: I slump down and swallow the thing into my gel.
I've swallowed it into myself.
In a moment it works its way out.
I'm not much good at holding things.
Too hard. I can't wrap it.
You dropped it; I'm sitting on it.
I slide off and there it is.
My glow shows it plainly.
This does nothing for me.

lines.zh: 我黏不住它，它滑了出来。
lines.en: I cannot stick to it; it slides free.
I face you and gather force.
My glow has brightened.
This hop is aimed at you.
However far you go, I can hop it.
I've flattened my body.
I leave marks on the ground.
I land by your feet and my light flickers
But I keep getting closer.
There's no dodging in this space.

lines.zh: 我的光缩成一团，对准你。
lines.en: My glow gathers into a ball aimed at you.
Hop by hop, I close in.
You go left; I angle left.
I light the ground as I come.
You've stepped into my glow.
Each landing is nearer.
You retreat; I hop after you.
My body presses the path flat.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛也知道你在哪
lines.en: I know where you are without eyes.
Two more hops.
Now it's my turn to hop over.
I press my whole mass on your leg.
That lands heavy and sticky.
You're shoved back a step.
The glow clings to you.

lines.zh: 我的身体弹回来，又上去
lines.en: I bounce back and come again.
A lit smear on your armour.

lines.zh: 我整个人砸在你的脚背上。
lines.en: I drop my whole bulk on your foot.
This hop lands on your chest.
The light follows me.
You pull away; the stickiness stays.
A blob of light appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 我先是一小点，然后变大
lines.en: A speck first, then I swell.
My glow lights the surroundings.
I shouldn't be in this area.
Someone put me here.
I land without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从光里一点点凝出来。
lines.en: I condense out of the light bit by bit.
First, two hops on the spot.
My glow has steadied.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有动静的方向去
lines.en: I drift toward the movement.
Heat stiffens my body.
I land and splatter wide.

lines.zh: 水渗进胶里，我的光发糊。
lines.en: Water seeps into my gel; my glow blurs.
The blast scatters my light.

lines.zh: 洞里漏出光，像开了一扇窗。
lines.en: Light leaks from the hole like a small window.
That light is as bright as mine.
I'm dimming and can't hop.
Lightning strikes and my whole mass shakes.
No ground. I come apart.
